title: Chapter 573
text:
The leader of the official reception team walked out and said respectfully,

"On behalf of the Godoran officials, I welcome the various Army Commanders. We have invited all of you to participate in the celebration, and we thank all of you for your participation. The matters related to the celebration are currently being prepared, and during this period, we will be in charge of your daily needs. If you have any requests, please come with me.

Millions of mercenaries walked in. Luckily, the Godora officials were a Star System civilization and had arranged everyone's accommodations well.

Godora's celebration would take a few days to prepare, so everyone could only wait for the celebration to begin on Godora's mother planet.

The celebration would be held in the capital, and everyone stayed there. The Army Commanders stayed in the same official guest house, and because there were too many mercenaries under them, they stayed in other places. However, only the Army Commanders were invited to attend the celebration. The millions of people could only watch the broadcast and could not squeeze into the venue.

The hundreds of thousands of players scattered in the capital would definitely not stay in their rooms obediently. Han Xiao did not want to restrict the freedom of the players. The players would not have a good impression of a faction that forced them to join. He could only use benefits and feelings to guide them. This was what he had always done.

The players were treated the same as the other mercenaries. When they were not carrying out missions, they were not allowed to do anything as long as they did not break the law.

Furthermore, the players would only be able to experience the warmth of home in the Black Star Corps if they took the initiative to understand the cost of living in the galaxy.

…

After separating from the officers, Han Xiao and the other Army Commanders followed the receptionist to the official guest house. This guest house was used to welcome foreign guests and was not open to the public.

Along the way, Han Xiao chatted casually with the various Army Commanders. The few Army Commanders like Justin who did not have any cooperation agreements took the initiative to form an alliance with Han Xiao.

He also took the opportunity to observe the scenery on Godora's mother planet. The sky was blue, and people using flying badges were flying in the sky like bridges. The tall and slender golden buildings pointed to the sky, and every floor had a landing point. The scenery was similar to what he remembered.

The magnificent and luxurious official guest house was built on the mountain. The receptionist led the group to their respective rooms. Every room was not small, and they had all the necessary facilities. They were all two-story duplexes with huge floor-to-ceiling windows and balconies, overlooking half of the capital. The scenery was unobstructed, and the air was very fresh. The environment was beautiful.

After Han Xiao arrived at his room, the receptionist left and did not disturb him any further.

"These conditions are not bad."

Han Xiao walked around upstairs and downstairs. He opened the fridge and took a look. It was filled with Godora's specialties and all kinds of drinks.

He took out a cube of frozen red meat and put it into a simple automatic cooking machine that looked like a fireplace. He set the flavor of "Godora's traditional sauce" and started the machine.

After a short while, a plate of steaming hot diced meat came out of the oven. A rich golden sauce was drizzled on top of it like honey. It had the flavor of Godora, and it emitted an appetizing aroma.

"I can finally save my taste buds that have been ravaged by the high-calorie nutrition cream."

Han Xiao took a deep breath of the meat aroma and his appetite was stimulated. He ate the diced meat in one bite as if he was eating snacks. The taste was sweet, and the meat was fresh and tender. It bounced between his teeth and actually had a jelly-like texture.

Godora was a civilization that was close to magic. There used to be countless ferocious magical beasts on their mother planet. Now, they were all locked up in zoos for people to visit. Some of the tasty beasts had become common food and were artificially bred. The meat of beasts that contained magic was often very delicious.

He casually took out a red fruit that looked like two buttocks from the fridge and an unopened bottle of pale golden wine. He walked to the balcony and leaned against the lounge chair. He drank wine and ate fruits while admiring the scenery of Godora's mother planet. He enjoyed the evil capitalist lifestyle. The word "satisfied" seemed to be written all over his face.

In his previous life, Dark-star had troubled Godora for a long time. Now that it had been destroyed in advance, hundreds of millions of creatures that were originally harmed by Dark-star had indirectly survived.

The biggest threat, Dark-star, had been destroyed. There were no more enemies eyeing them. Finally, there was a period of stability. They could peacefully carry out the expansion plan of the Black Star Corps. There should not be too big of a crisis before the next version. The overall situation was set. It should be fine to heal himself …

Not long ago, Han Xiao had used the Destiny's Child card to foresee the situation of Ashes. Ashes was indeed still alive. However, unexpectedly, the foresight showed that Ashes was dead. In layman's terms, he had divined that Ashes's glabella had turned black. There would be a bloody disaster in the near future.

Foresight was not omnipotent. It was a pity that he could not foresee where Ashes would appear and could not kill him.

Although he could not personally kill Ashes, he seemed to be in trouble. Han Xiao was curious about what kind of fatal danger Ashes would encounter. The biggest possibility was that he would encounter Godora's troops and be beaten to death. It was a pity that the foresight itself was very vague, and he could only make wild guesses.

I have changed the plot of Dark-star. The future events will not happen again. The fates of those Dark-star members will also be different, Han Xiao thought to himself.

Ever since Version 1.0, the boss of the Garton Star System, DarkStar, had been like the Sword of Damocles hanging over his head. Now that he had finally gotten rid of DarkStar, there would not be another powerful enemy in the Garton Star System for the time being. Furthermore, he had been in cahoots with Godora, so his base was basically safe.

Therefore, he was in a very good mood. He was very relaxed. He felt that the sun was so bright and the flowers were so red.

It has been a few years since I entered the galaxy …

While drinking, Han Xiao could not help but think about his experiences in the galaxy.

He had formed the Black Star Mercenary, fought all over the world, and joined the Dragon Emperor. Using her as his backer, he had interacted with the various large organizations and accumulated his strength in Version 1.0. After Version 2.0, he had returned to Blue Star and carried out his plan to recruit players. During this period, he had started a deeper cooperation with Godora, solved the Mutation Disaster, and destroyed Dark-star …

Now, he had finally accumulated enough strength to gain a foothold in the galaxy.

"The next step is to rise up."

Han Xiao gulped down a mouthful of wine. His eyes kept changing, and all kinds of thoughts popped up in his mind.

…

After resting for a while, an upper echelon of the War Bureau came to the official guest house and invited all the Army Commanders for a meeting.

Han Xiao had also received the notice. He wore a handsome windbreaker, combed his hair, and walked into the meeting room while humming a tune. He immediately saw Underworld Feather and Gureja. These two had arrived the earliest.

After sitting down, he chatted with the two of them. Gureja liked to touch people's legs while chatting, and Underworld Feather also ate non-stop. After chatting for a while, the other Army Commanders arrived one after another.

After everyone had arrived, a Godora man dressed in an old-fashioned way walked into the room. This man was an upper echelon of the War Bureau, and Han Xiao had communicated with him many times through the communicator. Thus, he recognized him immediately.

The upper echelon of the War Bureau gave an official speech and expressed his gratitude to everyone. He then explained the things to take note of during the celebration. Most of the upper echelons of Godora would be present, including their leader, Serbia the Fifth. The celebration was extremely formal, so there were many rules that had to be followed.

The ten or so Army Commanders present were all leaders of large escort companies in their own territories. However, this was the first time they were participating in the celebration of a Star System Civilization. Even if they were extremely strong and arrogant, they did not dare act casually in the face of such a huge event. They listened to the things to take note of with a serious expression.

The meeting ended very quickly, and the various Army Commanders got up and prepared to leave.

At this moment, the upper echelon of the War Bureau suddenly called out to Han Xiao.

"Black Star, come with me. Serbia the Fifth invites you to meet him."

Pa!

All the Army Commanders stopped in their tracks, turned around, and stared at Han Xiao with bewildered expressions.

The leader of Godora was the leader of a Star System Civilization. He was a truly important figure. His status, influence, and power were much greater than the large mercenary groups. They would only be able to get close to Serbia the Fifth during the celebration …

However, such an important figure wanted to meet Black Star in private?

We're all Army Commanders. Why do you get special treatment?

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and was not surprised. He nodded and said, "I understand. Let's go."

The various Army Commanders looked at the back view of the two of them and looked at each other with confusion in their eyes.

There was definitely something fishy going on!

Godora had not made any information public yet, so the Army Commanders did not know that Han Xiao was the key to their victory. His contribution was different from theirs.

…

After going around in circles, the two of them entered the political core building. After going through many restrictions, they came to the office of the highest leader and met Serbia the Fifth.

Serbia the Fifth stood up and extended his hand. He said in a friendly tone, "Black Star, how was your rest?"

"Not bad."

Han Xiao shook his hand and exchanged pleasantries.

There was also an upper echelon of the War Bureau beside him. The three of them sat down and chatted for a while before getting to the main topic.

"Black Star, your information helped us eliminate Dark-star." Serbia the Fifth did not put on airs. He stopped smiling and said in a serious tone, "I thank you on behalf of the people of Godora. Godora will remember your contributions."

"As a citizen of the Garton Star System, this is what I should do. It's just a small task," Han Xiao said humbly.

"Your award ceremony will be more grand. We will award you the 'Golden Gal Badge'. This is Godora's highest honor badge. Only thirty-two badges have been issued so far."

"Then I'm really flattered." Han Xiao raised his brows.

"This is what you deserve. As for the reward you requested, we have already prepared it."

As soon as Serbia the Fifth said that, the upper echelon of the War Bureau beside him took out his communicator and projected the models of the two spaceships.

"Fifty Berserk Falcon battleships with both assault and defense functions. One Fortress-class flagship, galactic aircraft carrier. The hull is made of high-strength alloy and is very tough. These fifty-one battleships are completely new and are now stored in the military warehouse. They can be handed over to you at any time. "

According to the requirements, these two battleships were purely technology-type and not Godora's own models.

Including these battleships, Han Xiao had a total of sixty to seventy spaceships. His fleet was finally of a certain size.

Han Xiao browsed through the parameters of the various spaceships and nodded. Godora did not fool him. These two spaceships were very good models, especially the Fortress-class flagship. Its price was above ten million Enas, and its cost was in the millions. Among all the spaceship models, flagships, main ships, and motherships were the most expensive.

Just these fifty-one battleships alone were worth tens of millions of Enas.

After confirming that there were no problems with the spaceships, the upper echelon of the War Bureau continued.

"The final payment of fifteen million Enas has been transferred to your account. Take a look."

The notification of the transfer indeed appeared on the communicator. Han Xiao looked at his balance and used all his willpower to control his facial expression so that he did not burst out laughing.

With the final payment of fifteen million Enas and the remuneration of the war employment, Han Xiao now had a total of twenty-eight million Enas!

What a windfall!

"As for the Super knowledge you requested, we can provide you with five. This is the list."

Han Xiao took a look. The Super knowledge of a Star System civilization was naturally more comprehensive than that of the black market. Some of them could not even be found on the black market. Now that they were placed in front of him for him to choose from, it saved him a lot of time. However, the highest knowledge on the list was only High-End knowledge.

Without hesitation, Han Xiao chose the High-End Mechanic knowledge that he had not learned yet.

Armed Branch — [High-End Material Technology]. Core knowledge of the Mechanic class. Research and development of higher strength materials. The most obvious effect was that it would greatly increase the armor value of all machines!

Energy Branch — [Super Nano Power]. Increase the basic attributes of mechanical suits and mechanical soldiers. Together with [High-End Material Technology], it would be able to develop advanced memory alloys that could automatically recover armor value. At the same time, it would be able to learn the blueprints of nanomachines and even give machines the ability to transform!

Energy Branch — [High Energy Weaponization]. Together with [High Energy Control], it would be able to fuse many powerful mechanical weapons!

Control Branch — [Interstellar Navigation Technology]. Prerequisite knowledge for independently building spaceships!

Control Branch — [Advanced Quantum Entanglement]. Greatly increase the distance of energy and information transmission, increasing the efficiency and range of Virtual Intrusion!

The upper echelons of the War Bureau directly took out the information from the knowledge base and sent it to Han Xiao's communicator.

Han Xiao suppressed the urge to immediately throw in his Potential Points to learn.

He had basically gotten the profits from selling the intelligence. All that was left was for Godora to announce his contribution during the official celebration and gain some fame.

The result of this cooperation could be said to be a happy one for both parties.

After chatting for a while more, Han Xiao stood up and left, following the upper echelons of the War Bureau to the door of the office. At this time, Han Xiao suddenly had an idea. He secretly threw an Observer's Mark on Serbia the Fifth.

The highest leaders often dealt with confidential matters. If he spied on Serbia the Fifth, he might be able to obtain a lot of confidential information.

It was definitely not because he was curious about the private life of the leader of a Star System Civilization!

…

The next day, Han Xiao rented a machinery modification room.

Since he was on Godora's mother planet, he did not have to spend time on transportation. He directly bought the core materials needed to build a new mechanical suit from the War Bureau — Kyle Alloy, PR-909 Super Nano Polymer Fiber, and refined Overga Metal Ore.

These three types of extremely expensive control-level strategic materials, and Godora only bought them at cost price. However, it still cost him more than 100,000 Enas.

Coincidentally, he had obtained five new knowledges yesterday. Among them, [High-End Material Technology], [Super Nano Power], and [Advanced Quantum Entanglement] were all raised to the max level of Lv. 5, which cost him a total of fifty-one Potential Points.

His Potential Points were finally showing signs of running out. Once he opened the knowledge to upgrade, the consumption of Potential Points would be extremely fast.

Han Xiao used the new knowledge to perfect the mechanical suit blueprint. At the same time, he invested experience to raise the blueprint to the max level of Lv. 10 to ensure that the manufacturing effect was maximized.

This time, he was full of ambition. He was prepared to build a new mechanical suit that was suitable for Grade A combat power and above Purple Grade!
